# streamTXC

> Decentralized video streaming powered by IPFS and TEXITcoin (TXC). Files are pinned to IPFS, addressed by content hash (CID), and every upload + hosting payment is stamped on-chain — no accounts, no algorithm, no silent takedowns.

## How it works

- Upload a video. The file is hashed and pinned to IPFS; the CID is the permanent filename.
- A per-video TXC deposit address is generated. Pay-per-MB hosting in TXC, prepaid by month.
- The CID + payment is broadcast as a TXCV1M OP_RETURN on the TEXITcoin chain — a public, verifiable receipt.
- Anyone can stream, embed, or re-pin the CID. There are no accounts and no region locks.
